title: Committee of Supply debate on the Ministry of Health budget
what_it_is: A Committee of Supply debate on Head O, Ministry of Health, including an amendment to reduce the allocation by $100 and ministerial responses on healthcare financing, preventive care, workforce and mental health.
why_it_matters: The Ministry announced higher MediSave withdrawal limits for chronic and preventive care from January 2027, subsidised genetic testing for hereditary breast and ovarian cancer from December this year, and extension of MediShield Life and MediSave to cover preventive surgeries for HBOC later this year. It also set out community health posts and specialist-supported care in Woodlands, and an AI risk assessment tool for Healthier SG enrolees from early 2027.

key_points.point: Ms Mariam Jaafar moved an amendment to reduce the total sum allocated to Head O of the Estimates by $100.
key_points.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
key_points.quote: That the total sum allocated to Head O of the Estimates be reduced by $100.

key_points.point: Mr Ong Ye Kung said Singapore is now a super-aged society.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: So, as I speak, Singapore is a super-aged society.

key_points.point: The Government health budget is about 2.7% of GDP this year and is expected to rise to about 3.5% of GDP by 2030.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: The Government health budget today is about 2.7% of GDP this year, and it is expected to rise to about 3.5% of GDP by 2030.

key_points.point: MediSave limits for chronic and preventive care will rise from $500/$700 to $700/$1,000.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: we will raise MediSave limits from $500/$700 to $700/$1,000.

key_points.point: The MediSave changes will be effective January 2027.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: The changes will be effective January 2027.

key_points.point: The scheme will be renamed the MediSave Chronic and Preventive Care Scheme.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: We will rename it to "MediSave Chronic and Preventive Care Scheme"

key_points.point: The Chronic Disease Management Programme will include hyperthyroidism and hypothyroidism.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: We will also expand the list of conditions covered under the CDMP to include hyperthyroidism and hypothyroidism.

key_points.point: MOH is studying whether to include eczema in the Chronic Disease Management Programme.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: we are studying whether we can include other chronic conditions, such as eczema, in the CDMP.

key_points.point: From December this year, subsidised genetic testing will be offered to at-risk individuals for hereditary breast and ovarian cancer.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: From December this year, we will offer subsidised genetic testing to at risk individuals for HBOC

key_points.point: MediShield Life and MediSave will be extended to cover preventive surgeries for HBOC later this year.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: We will therefore extend MediShield Life and MediSave to cover preventive surgeries for HBOC later this year.

key_points.point: An AI risk assessment tool will be rolled out to doctors for all Healthier SG enrolees from early 2027.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: This AI risk assessment tool will be rolled out to doctors for all Healthier SG enrolees from early 2027.

key_points.point: MOH will change its Chinese name to 保健卫生部.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: we will change the Ministry's Chinese name to "保健卫生部"

key_points.point: Healthier SG Care Protocols for frailty and functional health, such as osteoporosis and dementia, will be rolled out in 2028.
key_points.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
key_points.quote: the development of Healthier SG Care Protocols related to frailty and functional health, such as for osteoporosis and dementia are progressing well and would be rolled out in 2028.

key_points.point: NHG Health has been progressively enhancing 11 Community Health Posts across Woodlands Town since the start of this year.
key_points.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
key_points.quote: NHG Health has been progressively enhancing 11 CHPs across Woodlands Town since the start of this year.

key_points.point: Woodlands Hospital will launch specialist-supported care in the community through enhanced CHPs and direct teleconsultation starting end of this month.
key_points.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
key_points.quote: Woodlands Hospital will launch a new initiative starting end of this month to provide specialist-supported care for patients in the community through the enhanced CHPs in Woodlands and direct teleconsultation with individuals.

key_points.point: Two Woodlands mosques will partner with NHG Health to provide CHP services by September 2026.
key_points.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
key_points.quote: the two mosques in Woodlands, An Nur Mosque and Yusof Ishak Mosque, will be partnering with NHG Health to provide CHP services by September 2026.

key_points.point: The Healthy 365 app feature will roll out progressively from June 2026.
key_points.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
key_points.quote: This feature will roll out progressively from June 2026.

key_points.point: MOH will continue to monitor international developments and learn from other countries on implementing a cohort smoking ban.
key_points.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
key_points.quote: we will continue to monitor international developments and learn from the experiences of other countries in how they implement a cohort smoking ban.

key_points.point: An accelerated undergraduate-to-Masters pathway for clinical psychologists can be completed in five years.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: this new accelerated pathway for undergraduate-to-Masters pathway can be completed in five years.

key_points.point: MOH will register five higher risk sub-disciplines of psychologists.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: We will be registering five higher risk sub-disciplines of psychologists

key_points.point: Detailed registration schedule, requirements and roadmaps will be announced by early 2027.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: The detailed registration schedule, requirements and roadmaps will be announced by early 2027.

key_points.point: By 2030, the number of CREST and COMIT teams will expand to 75 and 35 respectively.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: By 2030, we will expand the number of CREST and COMIT to 75 and 35 respectively.

key_points.point: MOH has been giving IMH additional funding to enhance psychiatric services and upgrade infrastructure.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: MOH has been giving IMH additional funding to enhance the psychiatric services and upgrade its infrastructure for better patient care

key_points.point: The healthcare workforce will need to grow by 20% by 2030.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: We will need to grow our healthcare workforce by 20% by 2030 to meet the projected manpower demand.

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh asked whether the Ministry plans to review MediSave withdrawal limits for Integrated Shield Plan premiums in the immediate term.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
key_points.quote: Does the Ministry plan to review this in the immediate term?

key_points.point: Ms Sylvia Lim asked for the present status of the review on breast-related surgical claims.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
key_points.quote: What is the present status of this review?

key_points.point: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song called for MOH to extend coverage for all chronic diseases under the Chronic Disease Management Programme, not just the 23 approved conditions.
key_points.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
key_points.quote: I repeat my call for MOH to extend coverage for all chronic diseases under the Chronic Disease Management Programme and not just the 23 approved conditions.

key_points.point: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan called for IMH to be positioned as a Centre of Excellence in psychiatric treatment and care.
key_points.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
key_points.quote: I rise to make the case that Singapore should position the Institute of Mental Health (IMH) as the true Centre of Excellence in psychiatric treatment and care

key_points.point: Mr Eric Chua proposed a rigorous, interdisciplinary national study on problematic pornography use in Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
key_points.quote: commission a rigorous, interdisciplinary national study on problematic pornography use in Singapore.

key_points.point: Mr Fadli Fawzi proposed two to three precinct pilots for a caregiver passport, for six to nine months, enrolling about 100 caregivers per pilot.
key_points.speaker: Mr Fadli Fawzi
key_points.quote: I propose starting with two to three precinct pilots, for six to nine months, enrolling about 100 caregivers per pilot

key_points.point: Ms He Ting Ru repeated her call to regulate professionals such as therapists and counsellors.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
key_points.quote: I would like to repeat my call to regulate professionals, such as therapists and counsellors

key_points.point: Mr Alex Yeo sought an update on including Care Protocols for Dementia and Osteoporosis under Healthier SG.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alex Yeo
key_points.quote: I would like to seek an update from the Minister on the progress in including Care Protocols for Dementia and Osteoporosis under the Healthier SG Programme

key_points.point: Mr Cai Yinzhou asked whether atopic eczema could be added to the Chronic Disease Management Programme.
key_points.speaker: Mr Cai Yinzhou
key_points.quote: Will the Ministry consider adding atopic eczema to the Chronic Disease Management Programme

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim suggested permitting carry-over of unspent MediSave limits for up to three years.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: we can permit carrying over of unspent limits for up to three years.

key_points.point: Mr Ong Ye Kung said he wants to see how to create more flexibility and will take the carry-over suggestion into account.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: I do want to see how we can create more flexibility and we will take your suggestion into account.

key_points.point: Mr Ng Chee Meng asked whether the means-tested Home Caregiving Grant could be expanded to caregivers of family members needing assistance with one to two Activities of Daily Living.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
key_points.quote: whether the Ministry will consider expanding the means-tested Home Caregiving Grant to provide more support for more caregivers

key_points.point: Dr Wan Rizal asked about the role and mandate of the Mental Health Office.
key_points.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
key_points.quote: Could the Minister elaborate on the role and mandate of the Mental Health Office?

key_points.point: Mr Yip Hon Weng asked whether MOH will review respite care so it becomes a standard, easily claimable entitlement.
key_points.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
key_points.quote: Will MOH review respite care so it becomes a standard, easily claimable entitlement?

key_points.point: Dr Haresh Singaraju asked to scale the Living Asset Map across all three clusters.
key_points.speaker: Dr Haresh Singaraju
key_points.quote: scale the Living Asset Map across all three clusters.

key_points.point: Mr Azhar Othman proposed using video calls for all hospitals and polyclinics to minimise waiting times and hassle for simple updates.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: If I may propose that we utilise video calls to all hospitals and polyclinics and minimise waiting times and the hassle of hospital visits for simple updates.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Terence Ho suggested establishing a community-based caregiving corps.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Terence Ho
key_points.quote: establish a community-based caregiving corps.

key_points.point: Dr Choo Pei Ling said the question is whether technology is deployed in ways that strengthen independence, reinforce the workforce and preserve sustainability.
key_points.speaker: Dr Choo Pei Ling
key_points.quote: The question is whether we deploy it in ways that strengthen independence, reinforce our workforce and preserve sustainability in the long term.

key_points.point: Mr Victor Lye suggested a caregiver housing carve-out.
key_points.speaker: Mr Victor Lye
key_points.quote: consider a caregiver housing carve-out.

key_points.point: Mr Tan Kiat How said MOH welcomes all suggestions from Members, including on the caregiver passport.
key_points.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
key_points.quote: we certainly welcome all suggestions from Members

key_points.point: Mr Ong Ye Kung said the video and information put out are serious and that people should examine if they really need a rider.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
key_points.quote: you have to examine if you really need a rider.

key_points.point: Ms Mariam Jaafar withdrew her amendment.
key_points.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
key_points.quote: I seek to withdraw my amendment.

what_happens_next: Ms Mariam Jaafar withdrew her amendment.
